report:
Urinary bladder, radical cystectomy

Received in formalin is a radical cystectomy specimen measuring 12.5 x 9.5 x 7.0 cm. Opening the bladder reveals a 55 mm solid / nodular tumour involving the trigone and left lateral wall. Attached organs: prostate and seminal vesicles grossly unremarkable. Sections are submitted in 18 blocks.

(A1-A2) right and left ureteral margins.
(A3) urethral margin.
(A4-A11) bladder tumour full thickness with perivesical fat.
(A12-A14) representative bladder mucosa.
(A15-A16) prostate and seminal vesicles.
(A17-A18) bilateral pelvic lymph nodes.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Radical cystectomy
- Tumour site: Trigone and left lateral wall
- Tumour size (greatest dimension): 55 mm
- Tumour configuration: Solid / nodular

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Urothelial carcinoma, micropapillary (40%)
- Histologic grade: High-grade
- Associated urothelial carcinoma in situ (UCIS): Present, extensive /
  multifocal
- Tumour extension (depth of invasion): Perivesical soft tissue, microscopic
  (pT3a)
- Lymphovascular invasion: Present
- Perineural invasion: Present
- Tumour histology:
  Sections of the urinary bladder show urothelial carcinoma, micropapillary (40%), high-grade. Small tight clusters and delicate papillary tufts without fibrovascular cores lie within prominent retraction spaces.

Margins
- Surgical margins: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma; CIS present at margin
  - Right ureteral margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma and CIS
  - Left ureteral margin: Involved by CIS
  - Urethral margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma and CIS
  - Perivesical soft tissue margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma
- Distance to closest margin: 8 mm (right posterolateral perivesical soft
  tissue)

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 3 of 22 involved (bilateral pelvic and left common
  iliac); common iliac nodes involved: 1
- Extranodal extension (ENE): Present
- Size of largest metastatic deposit: 14 mm

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT3a pN3

Additional findings
- Additional pathologic findings: Cystitis cystica et glandularis

URINARY BLADDER, radical cystectomy:
- UROTHELIAL CARCINOMA, MICROPAPILLARY (40%), high-grade, 55 mm
- Tumour invades perivesical soft tissue, microscopic
- Associated urothelial carcinoma in situ (present, extensive / multifocal)
- Surgical margins clear of invasive carcinoma and CIS
- 3 of 22 regional lymph nodes involved; extranodal extension present
- pT3a pN3 (AJCC 8th edition).
